rancher_1.name: Rancher
dialog: Take a deep breath. Go on!
Air like this, you don't get in the big cities. It's the grass and the open sky that do it.

cowgirl_1.name: Cowgirl
dialog: Welcome to Solaceon Town! Nothing here is in a hurry, and we like it that way.
Have a wander round. The old ruins at the east end of town are well worth a look.

twin.name: Girl
dialog: The grown-ups go into the ruins and come out talking about Unown.
I'm not allowed in on my own. I'm too little, they say. Hmph!

cowgirl_2.name: Cowgirl
dialog: Every so often I walk down to the Lost Tower on Route 209.
A Pokémon I grew up with is remembered there. I like to go and say hello.

rancher_2.name: Rancher
dialog: When I was a lad there was nothing here but fields and those old stones.
Then folk started bringing their Pokémon to the Day Care, and a town grew up round it.

rival.name: {rival}
dialog: The ruins are amazing, {player}. Go and see!
